Main_Ingredients: Finely ground coffee extracted with hot water under pressure
Description: Espresso is a small, concentrated coffee shot made by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee under pressure. It is also the base for many cafe drinks.
Best_For: People who enjoy a strong coffee flavor in a small serving

Flavor_Profile: Smooth, clean, and espresso-forward with a lighter body than straight espresso
Description: An Americano is made by adding hot water to espresso. It keeps an espresso-style flavor while creating a larger and milder black coffee drink.
Best_For: People who like black coffee without milk and prefer a smoother taste than espresso

Main_Ingredients: Espresso, steamed milk, and a thin layer of milk foam
Description: A latte is an espresso-based drink with a larger amount of steamed milk and a small amount of foam. The milk softens the espresso flavor.
Best_For: People who enjoy creamy coffee with a mild coffee taste

Main_Ingredients: Espresso, steamed milk, and milk foam
Flavor_Profile: Balanced, airy, layered, and stronger than a latte
Description: A cappuccino commonly combines espresso, steamed milk, and foam. Its thicker foam gives it a lighter texture and a clearer espresso taste than a latte.
Best_For: People who like milk foam and a balanced espresso flavor

Main_Ingredients: Espresso, chocolate, steamed milk, and optional whipped cream
Description: A mocha is similar to a latte but includes chocolate syrup or cocoa. It blends espresso bitterness with chocolate sweetness.
Best_For: People who enjoy chocolate, sweet coffee, or dessert-style drinks
